title: Agent findings file
description: Shared output shape for every review/analysis agent in the Ecommerce-Redo quality system. Each agent writes one file to .agent-results/ matching this schema.

agent.description: Name of the producing agent, e.g. security-reviewer.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the file was written.

baseline_commit.description: Git commit SHA the findings were produced against (git rev-parse HEAD).

id.description: Unique finding ID, prefixed by area (SEC-, ADV-, BLOAT-, PERF-).

category.description: What class of issue this is, e.g. authorization, nplus1, unused-dependency, concurrency.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the offending file (or the test file for adversarial findings).

description.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: Exact code, scanner hit, or measurement that proves the issue is real.

reproduction.description: Concrete steps, command, or curl to reproduce.

recommended_fix.description: Minimal change that addresses the finding without violating global rules.

validation.description: How the fix is proven. Either a string (test command/description) or, for high/critical efficiency findings, an object with method/baseline/target per benchmark-policy.md.
